full_judgment: 3. Facts, in short, of the case are that, after holding preliminary enquiry by Bureau of Anticorruption one Selina Akhter, Inspector District Anticorruption Bureau, Khulna. lodged a First Information Report on 30-5-1996 with Koyra Police Station stating, inter alia, that, accused Md Aminor Sana and others along with the petitioner, an Assistant Settlement Officer, Rupsha during the period from 25-5-1980 to 30-1-1989 in collusion with each other, created false settlement deeds in favour of accused Mizanur Rahman and others, appertaining to government Khas lands and for illegal pecuniary benefit, accused Mannan Molla, Surveyor, provided the accused with field parcha by opening new Buzrat Khatians and the petitioner in his capacity as an Assistant Settlement Officer, by abusing his position, as such, obtained for himself and for other persons pecuniary advantage and attested the Khatians on the basis of the fabricated deeds in spite of knowing that the lands were Govt Khas lands as reported to him by Assistant Tahsilder Abdus Samad and thus the accused committed offence punishable under sections 419/420/461/468/491/109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of Act II of 1947. After investigation charge- sheet was submitted against the accused petitioner and others under the aforesaid "sections of law. Charges have been framed against the petitioner and others under sections 420/109, 468/109, 471/109, of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of Act II of 1947 and (7) seven witnesses have already been examined out of 10(ten) witnesses cited in the charge-sheet. At this stage the Special Public Prosecutor, Khulna enclosing a letter of the Government filed an application on 10-10-2001 for withdrawal of the accused petitioner from prosecution. The learned Special Judge by impugned order dated 22-10-2001 rejected the application for withdrawal. Hence is this Rule.
